title: Pod Salt Fusion Marshmallow Man Nic Salt E-Liquid - 20mg
description: This mouth-watering concoction is a collaboration between Pod Salt and Marina, the makers of the legendary Marshmallow Man range. The e-liquid’s third iteration brings all the light, gooey sweetness of marshmallows with a touch of vanilla, but adds a fruity layer that makes this juice a must for any vaper with a sweet tooth. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
